name: Electric Mobility Device
description: A two- or three-wheeled vehicle with an electric motor that isn't an electric-assisted bicycle and can go faster than 20 mph on motor power alone. Unlike an e-bike it's a motor vehicle, and one with a seat or saddle is also a motorcycle.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels and an electric motor for propulsion
Capable of more than 20 mph on motor power alone
An e-bike outside the electric-assisted bicycle limits (operable pedals, 750 watts, class speeds) that can top 20 mph on its motor lands here
A motor vehicle under the Motor Vehicle Code; electric-assisted bicycles are expressly excluded, it is not
Not on the list of vehicles exempt from title and registration, which names mopeds and electric-assisted bicycles
Counts as a motor vehicle for the Mandatory Financial Responsibility Act's liability insurance requirement
One with a seat or saddle for the rider is a motorcycle, needing a motorcycle endorsement
